letters.name: Nunito
letters.stack: "Nunito", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: Rounded ends, open shapes. The roundest that still reads as an adult letter. Figures tabular by default.

letters.name: Baloo 2
letters.stack: "Baloo2", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: Thick and friendly, about as wide as the default. Weak points: small capitals (0.62 of the size), and the combining tilde lands off centre on g and touches G: not for Guarani text.

letters.name: Gabarito
letters.stack: "Gabarito", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: The default, and the letter of the first skin. Warm geometric, and the narrowest of the normal widths.

letters.name: Schibsted Grotesk
letters.stack: "Schibsted", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: A newspaper's grotesque, the letter of the second skin. Wide: at distance 8 a long headline overflows its box until the player has a last step.

letters.name: Fira Sans
letters.stack: "FiraSans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.copyright: Copyright (c) 2012-2015, The Mozilla Foundation and Telefonica S.A.
letters.notes: Humanist, the most open shapes of the list, as narrow as the default. The one for long notices in a normal width.

letters.name: Open Sans
letters.stack: "OpenSans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.copyright: Copyright 2020 The Open Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/opensans)
letters.notes: The width axis at 87.5, so it fits like the default (at 100 it is 17 % wider and overflows). The largest lowercase of the list and the weights that differ most.

letters.name: Public Sans
letters.stack: "PublicSans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.copyright: Copyright 2015 The Public Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/uswds/public-sans)
letters.notes: An American gothic, sober and institutional: public bodies, companies. Tall capitals, rather closed shapes.

letters.name: Bitter
letters.notes: A sturdy slab with a large lowercase: the serif that loses least from far away.

letters.name: Noto Serif
letters.notes: The classic text serif, the width axis at 80 so that it fits. For a university, a town hall. Its thin strokes are the weakest part at 8 m.

letters.name: Barlow Semi Condensed
letters.stack: "BarlowSemiCondensed", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: Narrow, from road signs and number plates. Long headlines hold a step larger. At 8 m 6 and 8 are the closest of the list.

letters.name: Archivo Condensed
letters.stack: "ArchivoCondensed", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: The narrowest of the list, 13 % under the default, with its letters still apart. For long texts. Its shapes close a lot.

letters.name: Bricolage Grotesque
letters.stack: "Bricolage", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.copyright: Copyright 2022 The Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors (https://github.com/ateliertriay/bricolage)
letters.notes: A quirky grotesque with ink traps, the letter of the third skin. Cultural centres, young organisations.

letters.name: Grandstander
letters.stack: "Grandstander", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
letters.notes: Informal, of a comic's lettering, upright and with a two-storey a. For the youngest. The 1 of the clock stands apart: it is tabular.
